verses.text: A psalm of David, to help remember. LORD, do not correct me when you are angry. Do not punish me in your burning anger.
Your arrows have pierced me. Your hand presses down hard on me.
My whole body is sick because of your anger. My bones have no health because of my sin.
My sins are like a flood over my head. They are like a load too heavy for me to carry.
My wounds stink and fill with pus because of my foolishness.
I am bent over and bowed down low. I go around crying all day long.
My back burns with pain. My whole body is sick.
I am weak and completely crushed. I groan because of the pain in my heart.
Lord, you know everything I long for. My groaning is not hidden from you.
My heart pounds. My strength is gone. Even the light has left my eyes.
My friends and companions stay away because of my sickness. My family stands far away.
Those who want to kill me set traps for me. Those who want to hurt me talk about ruining me. They plan lies all day long.
But I am like a deaf man who cannot hear, like a man who cannot speak and does not open his mouth.
I am like someone who does not hear, who has no answer to give.
LORD, I wait for you. You will answer, Lord my God.
I said, "Do not let them celebrate over me, or boast against me when my foot slips."
I am about to fall. My pain is always with me.
I admit my sin. I am troubled by what I have done wrong.
My enemies are strong and many. So many people hate me for no reason.
They pay me back evil for good. They attack me because I try to do what is good.
LORD, do not leave me. My God, do not be far from me.
Hurry to help me, Lord my saviour.
